The Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka

IT is hereby declared that the names of the members elected for each ward of the Local Authority indicated in Column II of the Schedule below and the Local Authorities Specified in Column II situated in the Administrative District specified in Column I and the name of members returned for the Local Authority are as Specified below.
